description: This file defines the PriceBooks class for managing price book entities in a CRM system. It includes properties for database table mappings, methods for updating prices, retrieving related products and services, and generating report queries.

classes.name: PriceBooks
classes.description: Represents a price book entity in the CRM, providing methods for managing price book data, related products/services, price updates, and report generation.

methods.name: PriceBooks
methods.description: Constructor that initializes logger, database connection, and column fields.

methods.name: save_module
methods.description: Performs actions when saving the module, such as updating list prices if currency has changed.

methods.name: updateListPrices
methods.description: Updates list prices for products in the price book when the currency changes.

methods.name: get_pricebook_products
methods.description: Retrieves products related to this price book, with options for actions and UI elements.

methods.name: get_pricebook_services
methods.description: Retrieves services related to this price book, similar to product retrieval.

methods.name: get_pricebook_noproduct
methods.description: Checks if the price book has no associated products.

methods.name: generateReportsQuery
methods.description: Generates the primary SQL query segment for reporting purposes related to this price book.

methods.name: generateReportsSecQuery
methods.description: Generates secondary SQL query segment for reporting relationships with other modules.

methods.name: setRelationTables
methods.description: Returns relation tables and fields for related modules such as Products and Services.
